cases.customer_question: Can the product being registered be listed under the Product Name 'Bluetooth Module' , and can the registration proceed after correcting missing member address information on the review page?
question_variants: Can we use 'Bluetooth Module' as the Product Name?
Is the review page acceptable for Bluetooth SIG registration?
Can the registration proceed after updating company city and postal code?
Is the member information complete enough for submission?
Can the qualification listing be finalized now?
cases.actual_issue: Final verification and approval of Bluetooth SIG qualification listing details before submission, including correct Product Name usage and completion of member profile information required for the review page.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Before submitting a Bluetooth qualification listing, the member must confirm that the product information shown in the review page is accurate. In this case, the product was confirmed to be registered as a Bluetooth Module, and missing company address fields were corrected so the registration page displayed properly. After review approval, the consultant finalized the submission and issued the SDoC.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant confirmed that using 'Bluetooth Module'  as the Product Name was acceptable for the registration target. After the customer updated missing Member Details fields such as Company City, State, and Postal Code, the consultant verified that the address information was correctly reflected on the review page. The updated review page was resent for confirmation. After the customer approved the review page, the consultant completed the registration process, generated the server-issued SDoC, and informed the customer that the compliance folder would be provided separately.
cases.decision_logic: Bluetooth qualification submissions require accurate product and member information before final submission. The review page must reflect the finalized Product Name and complete member address information so the listing and declaration records are correct before the registration is finalized.
cases.final_recommendation: Verify all review page fields before submission, especially Product Name and Member Details fields such as city, state, and postal code. Obtain customer approval of the final review page, then complete the submission and archive the issued SDoC and compliance documentation.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Incorrect or incomplete listing information can require withdrawal and resubmission of the qualification record, create inconsistencies between marketed product information and SIG records, or delay issuance of the final declaration and compliance package.
